name: scroll-progress
title: 滚动进度 Scroll Progress
description: 用顶部进度条或环形指示器显示页面、容器或区块的阅读进度。

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual form of the progress indicator.

props.name: position
props.description: Edge used by a fixed bar. Use `inline` to keep it in normal flow.

props.name: container
props.description: Scrollable element to observe instead of the page.

props.name: target
props.description: Element whose passage through the viewport defines the progress.

props.name: offset
props.description: Motion scroll offsets used when `target` is supplied.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of the circular indicator in pixels.

props.name: strokeWidth
props.description: Stroke width of the circular indicator in pixels.

props.name: smooth
props.description: Smooth abrupt scroll updates with a spring.

props.name: trackClassName
props.description: Classes applied to the inactive track.

props.name: indicatorClassName
props.description: Classes applied to the moving indicator.

usage: `ScrollProgress` 可以观察整个页面、指定滚动容器，或通过 `target` 只计算某个内容区块的经过进度。`variant="bar"` 适合全局阅读位置，`variant="circle"` 适合文章工具栏和沉浸式章节。
